categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation and fee-bumping logic in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` and `src/wallet/feebumper.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents unnatural locktime backdating on fee-bumped transactions that leaks an on-chain wallet fingerprint. When bumping fees, anti-fee-sniping roll can randomly set a locktime earlier than the original transaction (estimated at 200–300 occurrences per week), an edge-case privacy flaw noted in #26526.
